cost: For N tokens,V interned concepts,E edges, bags and storage O(N log(V+E)); conceptual compact byte count12C+17E+8T excludes BTreeMap/string/allocator overhead. Pair comparison O(P² times reader/logic work per block); training corpora retained, current block metas transient, optional kept metas cumulative. UPGMA recomputes O(n²) cross-pair visits each of n merges => O(n³) distance calls. Rendering squares O(number of metrics*n²) cells plus sort O(n²log n).
description: versification averages same-verse Dice versus maximum adjacent-verse Dice and keeps strict superiority. agree builds punctuation-free concept/edge multisets with ROOT for head0 or out-of-range. pairing rotates common keys by floor(n/2). measure_lex trains state then streams each dev block, combines reader and target autoencoder tail, records missing whole blocks separately from cross residual, optionally retains dev metas. block_meta interns concepts and ORs translation bits. Reports average normalized pair scores and order squares by tradition then UPGMA.

inverse: Empty pairing cannot divide by zero because no mapped item executes; it emits no pairs. Strict versification never keeps tied mean scores. Agreement excludes punctuation whereas storage includes it, so counts are not interchangeable. Whole absent blocks do not inflate cross verse counts.

Agreement ratios admit many bag triples and graphs; even exact concepts/edges counts lose token order and punctuation. Pairing is invertible for fixed ordered keys and rotation length; ratios alone do not recover keys. Storage counts admit graphs with identical cardinalities; masks alias indices separated by64. UPGMA leaf order admits many distance matrices satisfying the same sequence of strict-min/tie comparisons.
limitations: Source-derived effectful CLI/corpus paths only; no live model/annotator/training/filesystem/site run.
Finite synthetic helper checks and partial syntax; no universal proof or executable percent surrogate.
state: For agreement domain finite admitted counts with shared<=min(side totals), Dice lies[0,1], empty=0. UPGMA finite symmetric distances and representable sums, unique input indices. Membership interpretation requires distinct indices in0..64; modulo64 aliases outside it. Interner len<u32::MAX, arithmetic within u64, token head coordinates local to verse.
